h: Sincere Torah and Prayer Transform the Root of Sin

p: נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם הֵם
"Take a census of the sons of Gershon, they too,
by their fathers' house, by their families" (Bamidbar 4:22).
In the holy Zohar at the beginning of this parsha:
אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
"Fortunate is the man to whom Hashem does not reckon iniquity,
and in whose spirit there is no deceit" (Tehillim 32:2).
This pasuk — its beginning is not its end,
and its end is not its beginning, etc.;
for its beginning implies that he has iniquity
and HaKadosh Baruch Hu does not reckon it,
וְסוֹפֵיהּ מַשְׁמָע שֶׁאֵין לוֹ כְּלָל עָוֹן
while its end implies that he has no iniquity at all.
וְכֵן פֵּירֵשׁ בְּהַגָּהַת רַבִּי חַיִּים וִיטָאל זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
And so explained the gloss of Rabbi Chaim Vital, of blessed memory.
on the matter of the Minchah prayer
and the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ כַּד אָתֵי צַפְרָא וְכוּלֵּי
and afterward, "When the morning comes," etc.;
to whom Hashem does not reckon iniquity'
When there is no deceit in his spirit."
וְאֵיזֶה שַׁיָּיכוּת יֵשׁ לְכָל הַמַּאֲמָר הַזֶּה
and what connection this whole passage has
to the explanation of this pasuk;
and also what connection this opening has
וּשְׁמִי ה׳ לֹא נוֹדַעְתִּי לָהֶם (שְׁמוֹת ו, ג)
"But by My Name Hashem I did not make Myself known to them" (Shemos 6:3):
and elaborated on the four directions and the four elements,
"And as for what is written, 'Fortunate is the man' etc.
אֵימָתַי לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
when does Hashem not reckon iniquity to him?
When there is no deceit in his spirit."
And there too we must understand
שַׁיָּיכוּת הַדְּרוּשׁ לְהַפָּסוּק אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם וְגוֹ׳
the connection of the discourse to the pasuk "Fortunate is the man" etc.,
and the connection of the opening
to the pasuk "But by My Name Hashem" etc.
there, the main discourse in the holy Zohar
and likewise the four elements — fire, wind, water, earth
correspond to the four letters of the Name Havayah:
Yud is Chochmah, Hei is Binah;
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (II 175b):
"And the supernal Chesed goes forth from Chochmah;
correspond to the final Hei of the Name,
and the middah of Malchus is called "earth"
in many places in the holy Zohar;
and it corresponds to the west,
which is also the middah of Malchus,
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ג קיט, ב)
(as written in the holy Zohar III 119b);
and east, and likewise the element of wind,
correspond to the Vav of the Name,
which is the Tree of Life.
And in the soul there are five levels:
and the soul of the soul,
in which there are two levels,
And the nefesh is from the middah of Malchus,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג לט, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (III 39b),
as it says, "Let the earth bring forth"
which is the middah of Malchus
that from there all the souls fly forth;
"And the soul of my lord shall be
bound up in the bond of life
אֵת ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (שְׁמוּאֵל א כה, כט)
and "es Hashem" is the middah of Malchus,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קלה, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 135b):
this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos night,
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד ה׳ אַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁבְּשֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה
and it corresponds to the final Hei in the Name Havayah.
וְרוּחַ הוּא מִן אוֹת ו׳ מִן שֵׁם הֲוָיָה
And the ruach is from the letter Vav of the Name Havayah;
and the neshamah is from Binah,
and the soul of the soul
is from the letter Yud of the Name,
and in this there are two levels:
and from the upper tip of the Yud,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סה, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (III 65b);
דְּאִיקְרֵי אַיִן (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
and this corresponds to chayah and yechidah.

p: all the four upper sides that we mentioned,
אַף עַל גַּב דְּמִתְקַשְּׁרָן דָּא בְּדָא וְכוּלֵּי
although they are bound one to the other, etc.,
the existence of the world is more through ruach,
and the nefesh does not exist
and this is the secret of
גַּם בְּלֹא דַעַת נֶפֶשׁ לֹא טוֹב
'Also, without knowledge the soul is not good'
being from Binah, the upper Hei,
which is not so of the ruach,
nevertheless the main existence is through the ruach;
for the letter Vav is the middle bar,
which runs from end to end,
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר גַּם בְּלֹא דַעַת
And about this it says, "Also, without knowledge"
which is the secret of Da'as,
שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל לִזְכּוֹת לָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
that it cannot merit the light "that it was good."
"And as for what is written, 'Fortunate is the man' etc.
אֵימָתַי לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
when does Hashem not reckon iniquity to him?
When there is no deceit in his spirit."
That is, when he merits the ruach,
which is the secret of Da'as,
שֶׁהוּא מַבְרִיחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
which runs from end to end,
where darkness and "tohu vavohu" are mentioned,
which allude to the deeds of the wicked
that is, so was the intent
in the creation of the world,
and this is as written in the holy Zohar
except that which comes forth from within darkness,
except that which comes forth from within evil."
וְאָז לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
And then "Hashem does not reckon iniquity to him,"
"If your sins be like the years
these years that come in order
from the six days of Creation
they shall be made white as snow,"
"but by My Name Havayah I did not make Myself known to them":
שֶׁאַף שֶׁנּוֹדַע לָהֶם שֵׁם זֶה גַּם כֵּן
for although this Name too was known to them,
and Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
was himself a chariot for the Name Havayah,
until there was a complete nation,
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
for he was like Adam HaRishon
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
אַף שֶׁמִּצִּידּוֹ גַּם כֵּן לֹא יָדַע מֵרַע
although on his own part he too knew no evil
and did not need this clarification,
that when he was born the house filled with light;
nevertheless, with regard to the generation of the wilderness,
which was called "the generation of knowledge"
זָכָה הוּא גַּם כֵּן לִבְחִינַת הַדַּעַת
he too attained the aspect of Da'as;
and as written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 13):
And this is what it says,
"But by My Name Hashem I did not make Myself known to them":
that they did not attain the aspect of Da'as.
And this is what the holy Zohar concludes there:
Moshe was more complete than the Avos, etc.,
of the house of the supernal King," etc.

p: And likewise this is the matter
מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ
of what is written in the holy Zohar on this parsha,
that it opened with the matter of the Minchah prayer
which Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him, instituted,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ כַּד אָתֵי צַפְרָא וְכוּלֵּי
and afterward, "When the morning comes," etc.;
דְּאַפֵּיק בַּר נָשׁ מִפּוּמֵיהּ כִּדְקָא יָאוּת
that a person brings forth from his mouth properly,
a holy word of Torah and prayer," etc.
That is, the Targum renders "a living soul"
וְהָרוּחַ הוּא קוֹל תּוֹרָה וְקוֹל תְּפִלָּה
and the ruach is the voice of Torah and the voice of prayer,
in the manner of what it says,
"The voice is the voice of Yaakov":
the first "kol," with the letter Hei,
and the second "kol," with Vav, indicates Torah.
and stands in the place where it stands," etc.;
to whom Hashem does not reckon iniquity'
when? When there is no deceit in his spirit":
that is, when he attains the aspect of ruach,
which is from the secret of Da'as,
שֶׁהוּא מַבְרִיחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
which runs from end to end,
of the intent of the holy Zohar in Parshas Va'eira.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁאָז לֹא יַחְשׁוֹב ה׳ לוֹ עָוֹן
That is, then Hashem does not reckon iniquity to him,
that they come in order from the six days of Creation,
and willful sins become like merits, as stated.
And this is the opening that it opened with
נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם הֵם
"Take a census of the sons of Gershon, they too,
by their fathers' house, by their families";
for the expression "they too" is difficult;
and also why with the sons of Gershon it put
"by their fathers' house" before "by their families,"
while with the sons of Kehas and the sons of Merari
in the Midrash Rabbah too (Bamidbar Rabbah 6).
up to the middah of Atika,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא י, ב)
in the manner of what is written (Bava Basra 10b):
"Through what is the horn of Yisrael raised?
up to the middah of Atika;
שֶׁכֵּן לְשׁוֹן תָּרוּם אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
for the expression "raised" with regard to Hashem Yisbarach
Now with the sons of Kehas
that is, through the power of the Torah,
as written in the Midrash Rabbah,
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
and this is what is written in the holy Zohar mentioned above,
And with the sons of Gershon
the raising of the head is also written,
as written in the Midrash Rabbah.
That is, regarding the firstborn it says,
כִּי הוּא רֵאשִׁית אוֹנוֹ (דְּבָרִים כא, יז)
"for he is the first of his strength" (Devarim 21:17),
וְכֵן כְּתִיב כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי (בְּרֵאשִׁית מט, ג)
and likewise it is written, "my strength and the first of my vigor" (Bereishis 49:3);
that is, they have a holiness
that is bound to the beginning of the Thought,
the service was taken from them;
but the Levi'im, who did not sin,
retained the holiness of the firstborn,
the aspect of the head, the beginning of the Thought.
נָשֹׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם הֵם
"Take a census of the sons of Gershon, they too":
for through the power of the firstborn
they too merit the raising of the head.
And therefore with the sons of Gershon it put
"by their fathers' house" before "by their families,"
in the manner of what we said (Bamidbar, maamar 3):
that the expression "by their fathers' house"
for the task of each Nasi was
to raise the head of his tribe
and to clarify that they are bound at the root
to the beginning of the Thought,
to the Mazla, which is the aspect of Atika,
in the manner of what is written
in Asarah Maamaros of the Rema of Fano:
the soul of the father is the mazal of the son.
And this is why it put "by their fathers' house" first:
for the sons of Gershon merited this
as written in the Midrash Rabbah,
that their raising of the head
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכוּ לִנְשִׂיאַת רֹאשׁ
and through this they merited the raising of the head
as in the matter of what is said,
"Hashem does not reckon iniquity to him"
when? "When there is no deceit in his spirit":
the voice of Torah and the voice of prayer, as stated.
And on Shabbos all Yisrael merit
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
for his generation was the generation of knowledge,
and he was the aspect of Da'as.
And it is the time to repair all the past,
for it becomes clear: "If your sins be like the years
like these years that come in order
from the six days of Creation
they shall be made white as snow."

rich.text: “ראובן בכרי אתה כחי וראשית אוני יתר שאת ויתר עז”
— “Reuben, you are my first-born, My might and first fruit of my vigor, Exceeding in rankAnd exceeding in honor.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Yeshayahu 1:18 — “לכו נא ונוכחה יאמר יהוה אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים כשלג ילבינו אם יאדימו כתולע כצמר יהיו” — ““Come, let us reach an understanding, —says GOD.Be your sins like crimson, They can turn snow-white; Be they red as dyed wool, They can become like fleece.””

rich.text: “לכו נא ונוכחה יאמר יהוה אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים כשלג ילבינו אם יאדימו כתולע כצמר יהיו”
— ““Come, let us reach an understanding, —says GOD.Be your sins like crimson, They can turn snow-white; Be they red as dyed wool, They can become like fleece.””
